seed_cracker.help.copy: Once found, the seed appears in chat: click it to copy.
seed_cracker.help.decorations: Decorations, only needed when the server hides its seed:
seed_cracker.help.end_route: Fly past the obsidian pillars near the centre, then find end cities until the bar fills. This route needs no key finds.
seed_cracker.help.extra: Extra finds, they add bits but are not key:
seed_cracker.help.intro: Explore with the module on. Finds are read as chunks load and the seed is worked out by itself; the HUD panel shows how far along it is. The numbers are bits: how much one find narrows the seed.
seed_cracker.help.nether: The bedrock at the bottom and top of the Nether gives the low 48 bits of the seed with no structures. The Overworld's bedrock or the server's hashed seed gives the rest. It is read by itself as chunks load; the Bedrock setting turns it off.
seed_cracker.help.trust: If bedrock and structures point at different seeds, chat asks which to trust: %1$scracker trust bedrock, %1$scracker trust structures, or %1$scracker clear.
seed_cracker.hidden_hash: Seed Cracker: this server hides its hashed seed (0); the world seed needs dungeons, desert wells or end gateways
seed_cracker.hidden_hash.toast_message: The server hides it. The world seed needs dungeons, desert wells or end gateways.
